content.text: The document has no Section 20 and no indemnity language anywhere, despite dangling cross-references. Let me propose the insertion.

input.summary: Insert missing Section 20 (Indemnification): Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity, claim procedure, narrow Customer indemnity, and the Section 20.5 infringement remedies already cross-referenced.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, even though Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 already assume one (9.3 expressly cross-references Section 20.5). We have inserted our standard Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and wilful misconduct, with reciprocal claim-handling procedure, the infringement remedies, and a narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

ops.text: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

20.2 Customer shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Vendor from and against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (a) content or materials provided by Customer to Vendor, other than to the extent the claim arises from Vendor's use of that material in breach of this Agreement; or (b) Customer's breach of Applicable Law. This Section states Customer's only indemnity obligation.

20.3 The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, tender sole control of the defence and settlement (except that no settlement imposing liability, admission of fault, or a non-monetary obligation on the indemnified party may be made without its prior written consent), and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. The indemnified party may participate with counsel of its own choosing at its own cost. A delay in notice relieves the indemnifying party only to the extent it is materially prejudiced.

20.4 Vendor's obligations under Section 20.1(a) do not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's unauthorized modification of the Services or Deliverables, their combination with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would have been avoided but for the combination, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications.

20.5 If the Services or Deliverables are, or in Vendor's reasonable opinion are likely to become, the subject of an infringement claim, Vendor shall at its expense and Customer's option procure the right for Customer to continue using them, or modify or replace them with functionally equivalent, non-infringing items that continue to meet the agreed specifications and service levels. If neither option is reasonably available, Customer may terminate the affected Order Form and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the terminated period together with Fees paid for Services and Deliverables Customer can no longer reasonably use.
